headline: Language struct and translation operations
what_breaks: config/allconfig/configlanguage.go — depends on Language for language settings
why: This file defines the Language struct and the LanguageTranslateOps interface, which are critical for language handling and translation functionalities. Changes here can impact multiple components that rely on language configurations and translations.
checklist: Review changes to Language struct fields and methods
Check compatibility with LanguageTranslateOps interface implementations
Ensure that any modifications to NewLanguage function are reflected in dependent files
